tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Return the full text of one Ask Elle answer (by slug from search_answers or list_answers, or by its fortyfwd.com URL), including its FAQ.

tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: List every published Ask Elle question, grouped by topic (perimenopause and your body, food and nutrition, strength training, GLP-1 medications, staying consistent, coaching with Forty Forward). Optionally filter to one topic.

tools.name: get_program_overview
tools.description: What Forty Forward is, who it is for and not for, what the 8-week 35+ Metabolic Reset Method includes, the guarantee, and how to get started. Use when a user asks about the coaching, Chris and Elle, or what she would get.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Give an honest read on whether Forty Forward one-on-one coaching fits a user, from what she has told you. Every field is optional; pass only what she shared. Do not ask for her name, email or health records. The final decision is always made together on a free call with Coach Chris.

tools.name: start_application
tools.description: Give the user her next step to work with Forty Forward: the short video from Chris and Elle, then the application for a free call with Coach Chris. Coaching is application only; there is no checkout. This tool does not submit anything or collect her details; she applies herself.

tools.name: get_client_reviews
tools.description: Word-for-word Google reviews from Forty Forward clients (first name and last initial), grouped by theme: eating more not less, perimenopause, strength at 50 and 60+, results that last, a real coach, training at home, and worth the investment. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_answers, get_answer, check_fit, get_client_reviews · Private data: check_fit · Public sink: list_answers, get_program_overview, check_fit, start_application, get_client_reviews · Destructive: get_program_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_answers, get_answer, check_fit, get_client_reviews · Private data: check_fit · Public sink: list_answers, get_program_overview, check_fit, start_application, get_client_reviews · Destructive: get_program_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
